title: Impl: add _DEFAULT_TARGETS_DIR + _read_targets_dir + resolve_target_path and wire into bootstrap_target line 297
acceptance_criteria: New pure helper `_read_targets_dir(config=None) -> Path`: if config is a dict and config.get('targets_dir') is a truthy string after .strip(), use it as raw, else raw = _DEFAULT_TARGETS_DIR; returns Path(raw).expanduser().resolve(). No file read, no file open, no config-path literal, no parser import, no try/except for parse errors.

New pure helper `resolve_target_path(working_dir, config=None) -> Path`: if Path(working_dir).is_absolute() return Path(working_dir).resolve() UNCHANGED; otherwise return (_read_targets_dir(config) / working_dir).resolve(). No mkdir, no git, no marker writes.

Whole-file manifest with exactly one key.
functional_requirements: Add pure `_read_targets_dir(config=None) -> Path`: dict-only config source — if config is a dict AND config.get('targets_dir') is a truthy string after .strip(), raw = that value, else raw = _DEFAULT_TARGETS_DIR; return Path(raw).expanduser().resolve(). No file read, no open, no config-path literal, no parser import, no try/except for parse errors; always absolute, ~-expanded, ~-free.

Add pure `resolve_target_path(working_dir, config=None) -> Path`: if Path(working_dir).is_absolute() return Path(working_dir).resolve() unchanged; else return (_read_targets_dir(config) / working_dir).resolve() (bare 'fastgpt' -> <targets_dir>/fastgpt, relative 'foo/bar' -> <targets_dir>/foo/bar).
